title: Trips and travel
questions: What is the best trip you have ever taken?
Which country would you like to visit, and why?
Do you prefer to travel by plane, train or car?
What do you always pack in your bag before a trip?
Tell us about a problem you had while traveling.
What should a tourist see first in your city?
Where would you go this weekend if you could go anywhere?

title: Work and jobs
questions: What job would you like to have in five years?
What makes a good boss?
Would you prefer to work from home or in an office?
What was your first job, or the first job you want to have?
Which skill is the most useful at work?
How do you prepare for a job interview?
What did you learn this week, at work or outside work?

title: University life
questions: What are you studying, or what would you like to study?
How do you organize your week when you have a lot of work?
Do you prefer to study alone or with friends?
Which teacher helped you the most, and how?
What would you change at your university or school?
Would you like to study abroad? Where?
What is your favorite place to study?

title: Food and cooking
questions: What did you eat for breakfast today?
What is a traditional dish from your region? How is it made?
Do you like to cook? What can you cook well?
What food from another country would you like to try?
Do you prefer eating at home or at a restaurant?
What do you usually eat during Ramadan or on special days?
Describe your perfect weekend lunch.

title: Exams and learning English
questions: Why are you learning English?
What is the most difficult part of English for you?
How do you prepare for an important exam?
Do you get stressed before exams? What helps you?
Which English word did you learn recently?
Do you watch films or series in English? Which ones?
What is your goal in English for this month?

title: My city and neighborhood
questions: Describe the street where you live.
What do you like most about your city?
What is missing in your neighborhood?
How do you go to school or work every day?
Where do young people meet in your city?
Is your city better in summer or in winter? Why?
If you were the mayor, what would you change first?

title: Plans and dreams
questions: Where do you see yourself in ten years?
What is one dream you want to make real?
Would you like to start your own business? What kind?
Which person do you admire, and why?
What new skill do you want to learn this year?
Would you live in another country for work?
What advice would you give to your younger self?

title: Free time and hobbies
questions: What do you do to relax after a long day?
Do you play a sport? Which one?
What was the last book, film or series you liked?
Do you prefer spending time online or outside?
What hobby would you like to start?
How do you usually spend your Friday?
Tell us about a happy moment from this week.
